max_detection_range_m.description: Polygon-to-polygon distance threshold in meters between the ego footprint and an object polygon. Objects beyond this are filtered out before sector assignment.

include_unknown_objects.description: If false, objects whose classification contains UNKNOWN are dropped before sector assignment.

sector_boundary_tolerance_deg.description: [degree] Angular tolerance applied to each side of every sector wedge boundary.

sector_range_params.description: Per-sector angular extents as [from_deg, to_deg] in REP-103 bearing (+x forward, +y left, 0 = ahead). Half-open [from, to). The 8 sectors must tile the full circle without gaps or overlaps. Set to_deg < from_deg to wrap through +/-180 degrees.

front.description: [from_deg, to_deg] angular extent of the FRONT sector.

front_right.description: [from_deg, to_deg] angular extent of the FRONT_RIGHT sector.

right.description: [from_deg, to_deg] angular extent of the RIGHT sector.

rear_right.description: [from_deg, to_deg] angular extent of the REAR_RIGHT sector.

rear.description: [from_deg, to_deg] angular extent of the REAR sector. to_deg < from_deg wraps through +/-180 degrees.

rear_left.description: [from_deg, to_deg] angular extent of the REAR_LEFT sector.

left.description: [from_deg, to_deg] angular extent of the LEFT sector.

front_left.description: [from_deg, to_deg] angular extent of the FRONT_LEFT sector.
